faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RBU Technical Assistants (Museum) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 08-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Technical Assistants (Museum) at RBU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the post of Technical Assistants (Museum) at Rabindra Bharati University as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Technical Assistants (Museum) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Masters in Museology, knowledge of museum digital documentation, and at least 1 year of experience as a museum trainee.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need at least 1 year of experience as a museum trainee at the Rabindra Bharati Museum, along with experience in VIP guiding and antique object handling.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Hardcopy applications may also be accepted, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Technical Assistants (Museum) position?
faq.answer: The position is on a contractual basis, with the contract renewed every six months based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the official website of Rabindra Bharati University?
faq.answer: The official website of Rabindra Bharati University is www.rbu.ac.in, where you can find more information and updates.

faq.question: Q8. What languages are required for VIP guiding experience?
faq.answer: Experience in VIP guiding in three languages, namely Bengali, English, and Hindi, is required for this role.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age limit restrictions for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to check the detailed advertisement for any age-related criteria.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are needed when applying?
faq.answer: You will need to attach self-attested copies of your educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application.
